verticalFaqs.question: Does Duet work for booking and availability emails?
verticalFaqs.answer: Absolutely. Duet learns your trip types, pricing, availability, and policies. When a booking inquiry comes in, it drafts a complete response with the right details — pricing, what's included, meeting location, what to bring. You review and tap send.

verticalFaqs.question: I'm on the water all day. Can I use Duet from my phone?
verticalFaqs.answer: Yes. Duet works with Gmail and Outlook, so it works wherever your email works — including your phone. Drafts appear automatically. Between catches, you review and send with one tap. Most captains tell us it saves them 1-2 hours of email time per day during peak season.

pricingNote: At $500/charter, one saved booking pays for over a year of Pro.
